capabilities: show a clock in the status bar
toggle display of seconds in the clock
extras: Free; the author accepts donations via 'buy me a coffee'.
motivation: The author works in full screen mode often and could not see the time, so created the plugin.
problem: In full screen mode Obsidian hides the system clock, so the time is not visible while working.
summary: Status bar clock that displays the current time, optionally with seconds, in Obsidian's status bar.
